body:
> Why not, but it means we'll need to add it to each and every one of the new widgets using facets. Are we sure we want to do this?

Yes, but we can factorize the code like we do for header/footer for instance.

> About using the big one to display it, I strongly disagree though.

Hmmm, if it's for "performance" reason I would say it's a bad reason (until we actually detect one, but iterating over <5 refinements shouldn't be that intense + we could optimize the code if the underlying template it blank).

That being said, I agree it's not very developer-friendly; so I would maybe go for 2 widgets, but definitely use the same underlying components.

> I updated the main post to reflect these.

Actually, re-reading it I think `refinementList` is confusing here, we need to speak about the *refined*  values themselves. So either `currentRefinedValues` or `currentRefinements`.
